ycoss:11940.long_description: Keeper is AI tax filing for complex returns. We serve individuals and small businesses in the US. Today, over 50% of tax returns still get filed by accountants - that’s 75M returns a year. Unfortunately, great accountants are really hard to find, and the data shows most of them are retiring in the next 5-10 years. Keeper is the modern alternative. We use AI to automate most of the prep work, which frees up in-house human tax experts to focus on guidance and reviewing final results. The net outcome is that we’re able to deliver higher quality / more accurate returns at 50% of the cost of traditional accountants.

ycoss:22533.long_description: When the public cloud appeared migration was easy. Existing apps running on physical servers could just be moved to virtual machines running in the cloud. The cloud is now moving towards serverless, and serverless is not backward compatible. New tools need to be created and existing apps need to be rewritten. Webiny provides developers with everything they need to build those serverless apps. We are a 100% remote team.
